description: This PHP source file defines the SAP SQL Anywhere database driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer, including the ADODB_sqlanywhere class with methods for handling blob data, inserting IDs, and establishing database-specific behavior.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A class representing the SAP SQL Anywhere database driver, extending the ODBC driver with methods for blob handling, ID retrieval, and driver-specific operations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A class representing a record set for SQL Anywhere, extending the generic ODBC record set.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value from the database.

methods.name: create_blobvar
methods.description: Creates a binary large object (BLOB) variable in the database session.

methods.name: drop_blobvar
methods.description: Drops a BLOB variable from the database session.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_file
methods.description: Loads binary data from a file into a BLOB variable in the database by reading the file in chunks and converting to hex.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_var
methods.description: Appends binary data from a string variable into a BLOB variable in the database.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in a table by loading binary data into a session variable and executing an update statement.
